prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (airbrush) tans or UV tanning beds? And which part of Charlotte (zip code or neighborhood) are you in?

If you want a quick way to find the “best” place for your needs, give me your preference and location and I’ll pull up highly rated salons near you. If you want general guidance now, here are quick tips to choose a top tanning salon:

- Decide spray vs. UV: spray tans are safer (no UV) and give immediate color; UV beds can increase skin cancer risk.
- Check recent reviews on Google and Yelp (4.5+ stars and lots of recent reviews are a good sign).
- Look at before/after photos on the salon’s website or Instagram to judge results.
- Ask what solutions/brands they use (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic, etc.) and whether they offer custom color mixes.
- For spray tans, ask if they do airbrush (technician-applied) vs automated booths, and whether they include pre/post tan instructions and an option for touch-ups.
- For UV tanning, check bed maintenance, lamp age/replacement policy, and staff training/certifications—also confirm they follow safety exposure guidelines.
- Inspect cleanliness and ventilation in person; a good salon will let you tour and answer questions.
- Compare pricing, packages, and membership deals, and ask about a satisfaction guarantee.

Tell me spray vs. UV and your neighborhood/zip code and I’ll recommend specific, top-rated Charlotte salons.
